title: Main loop never sees flag set in ISR at -O2
user_question: Works with -O0 in debug, hangs forever with -O2 in release. Breakpoint in the ISR does hit.

reference_context.title: GNU C / ld Documentation
reference_context.snippet: Accesses to volatile objects are evaluated strictly according to the rules of the abstract machine. Without volatile, the compiler may keep a variable in a register and assume it does not change unless the current code modifies it.

expected.root_cause: data_ready is shared with an ISR but not declared volatile, so at -O2 the compiler hoists the load out of the busy-wait loop and spins forever.
expected.fix: Declare it as static volatile uint8_t data_ready.
